groundTruthSource.note: Reviewed at this commit: pyproject.toml line 42 starts the django extra, which lists django>=4.2 on line 43. uv.lock has a django 4.2.30 entry (lines 1402-1408) whose resolution-markers are python_full_version == '3.9.*' or < '3.9', and the django extra selects it for python_full_version < '3.10' (lines 351-355). requires-python is >=3.8, so installing the extra on Python 3.8 or 3.9 resolves Django 4.2, which has been end-of-life since 2026-04-07. The 5.2.17 and 6.1.1 entries apply to newer Pythons and are not reported.
